entities.summary: Father Julio Meinvielle was an Argentine priest and prolific writer. A leading Roman Catholic Church thinker of his time, he was associated with the far right tendency within Argentine Catholic thinking. As a polemicist he had a strong influence on the development of nacionalismo. Julio Meinvielle was a philosophers & thinkers from Buenos Aires (1905-08-31, Buenos Aires–1973-08-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
